epics.title: D365FOMiddleware_Nestbackend: Cash Processing and D365FO Settlement
epics.description:
Objective

Deliver reliable cash processing in the D365FO middleware, from Excel batch intake through validation, journal creation, settlement, and operational export. The work improves the separation of cash processing policies, the accuracy of customer and vendor settlements, and the ability to diagnose and recover failed batches.

Repository and change scope

  • Azure DevOps project: D365FOMiddleware_Nestbackend
  • Target branch: cash-base-processor-refactor
  • Committed history reviewed: 92 commits after azure/production, dated 17 August–10 September 2026. The commits refactor cash processing and add or fix vendor payment validation, withholding, customer settlement, data-batch downloads, and deployment behavior.
  • Working-tree implementation: 102 changed or newly added middleware files were committed as db59546 on 19 October 2026. These include cash processor and D365FO journal changes, Shiplink settlement export, enhanced batch downloads, Excel handling, queue routing, tests, deployment configuration, and data-architecture documentation.

Workstreams

  1. Cash-In and customer settlement: preserve source identifiers and paired lines; apply account, currency, and exchange-rate rules; post and settle Shiplink/Yard receipts against suitable open customer transactions; handle unmatched lines and long payment references.
  2. Cash-Out, vendor settlement, and withholding: validate supplier invoices; reconcile gross/net values and withholding; settle custody payments by UniqueId; aggregate split invoices; prevent duplicate marks and retries; preserve useful failure details.
  3. Batch exports and operations: download enhanced records and exact Shiplink settlement payloads; preserve source workbook fields; improve Excel data handling and batch diagnostics.
  4. Shared cash foundation and deployment: separate processor policies and direction-specific builders; harden routing and prevalidation; align D365FO journal payloads, runtime configuration, and production image settings.
  5. Data architecture: document entities, relationships, indexes, mappings, lineage, data integrity, and known schema gaps with evidence and diagrams.

Acceptance criteria

  • Cash-In and Cash-Out are routed and validated using the correct direction, processor, account, currency, and D365FO payload contract.
  • Settlement selection respects invoice/customer identity and payment amount; retries do not duplicate successful marks or discard failed work.
  • Shiplink/Yard unmatched and split settlement cases remain diagnosable and do not invalidate otherwise valid receipts.
  • Batch exports contain the relevant source/enhanced data and exact settlement payload fields, with clear errors for incomplete Finance data.
  • Validation errors identify the missing or invalid field and provide useful source context and remediation.
  • Changed policies, builders, journal services, queue routing, downloads, and Excel behavior have corresponding regression coverage.
  • Architecture documentation distinguishes verified relationships from assumptions and links conclusions to evidence.

Traceability

Feature and child work items carry the relevant commit identifiers and code areas. The reviewed commit range is ef6d5de–004e498 (92 commits). The local implementation captured in the repository is commit db59546; it contains 102 files changed with 8,360 insertions and 511 deletions.

tasks.title: Implement and harden Shiplink/Yard cash-in posting and invoice settlement
tasks.description:
Work summary

As an Operations finance user, I need Shiplink/Yard cash receipts to post and settle the correct customer invoices, so receipts reconcile in D365FO without losing unmatched work. Support processor routing, debit batch splitting, unmarked receipt posting followed by amount-based settlement, source line/payment identity, due date propagation and selection of an open CustTrans covering each payment line. Skip unmatched settlements safely and report them.

Commit and change evidence

commits 5f0cf20 (2026-09-06 20:39), 403bbe7 (2026-09-06 21:39), ae75b25 (2026-09-07 08:49), ef6e8a1 (2026-09-07 09:24), 42e5aeb (2026-09-09 09:18); current changes in cash-in direct processor/builder, customer settlement service and queue strategy.

Acceptance criteria

  • correct amount, customer, invoice and due date reach D365FO
  • open CustTrans selection covers payment amount
  • unmatched entries do not fail the batch
  • tests cover credit/debit, split, missing invoice and unmatched cases.

backlogItems.title: Separate Shiplink/Yard cash-in transformation from settlement posting
backlogItems.description:
Work summary

Refine direct cash-in builder and processor behavior for source credit/debit columns. Post receipt lines without inappropriate invoice MarkedLines, then execute amount-based settlement only when required. Preserve customer, invoice, payment ID, currency and source reference.

Code areas

src/modules/cash/processors/inbound/direct/*; src/modules/cash/handlers/post-cash-batch-to-dfo.handler.ts. Includes current uncommitted separation of receipt posting and invoice settlement.

backlogItems.title: Select covering open customer transactions and pass due dates
backlogItems.description:
Work summary

Update customer-payment-journal-settlement.service and posting strategy to select an open CustTrans covering each payment line and include invoice due date in settlement requests. Avoid settling more than the payment amount. Add regression cases for competing transactions, partial amount and due-date mapping.

Commit and change evidence

commits ef6e8a1 and ae75b25 (2026-09-07).

backlogItems.title: Split Shiplink/Yard debit batches and report unmatched settlements
backlogItems.description:
Work summary

Partition debit batches as required for Shiplink/Yard posting, skip invoice settlement when the referenced open invoice cannot be matched, and retain actionable per-line outcomes. Verify queue routing and D365FO posting do not turn a valid receipt into a permanent batch failure.

Commit and change evidence

commit 42e5aeb (2026-09-09).

backlogItems.title: Preserve and validate source PAYMENTREFERENCE
backlogItems.description:
Work summary

Keep the original PAYMENTREFERENCE in formatted lines and reject values exceeding the D365FO maximum of 35 characters with an actionable validation message.

Commit and change evidence

commits 22d5cd9 (2026-09-09) and 004e498 (2026-09-10), plus current base processor, direct line validator and cash line-builder changes.

tasks.title: Implement safe UniqueId-based vendor payment and custody settlement
tasks.description:
Work summary

Validate supplier invoice identity and amounts, aggregate split settlements, defer marks until posting succeeds, upload marked UniqueIds without MarkedLines, remove request caps and skip failed IDs with a clear result.

Commit and change evidence

commits 95095f1, 1ffe645, 1daad06, 7f0a47c, 4022aaf, e0076ce and c1d355e (2026-09-01).

Acceptance criteria
